_comment: Source-of-truth catalog of AI-tool affiliate programs. Consumed by scripts/affiliate-audit.mjs and any future passive-income site/repo. Set ourLink when you have a signed-up affiliate URL; null = not yet joined. Researched 2026-06-05; re-verification pass 2026-07-11 against knowledge/07-field-dossier.md — entries with verifiedAt trace to the dossier; all others carry an unverified note. Verify commercial terms before relying on them — affiliate terms change often. Affiliate-term refresh 2026-09-28: entries with commissionVerifiedAt or verifiedAt 2026-09-28 were re-read against the program's own page (commissionSourceUrl); Copy.ai removed (no official terms page), Perplexity closed, Notion reopened (superseded 2026-09-29: notion.com/affiliates reads "not accepting new affiliates", so closed). Second pass 2026-09-28: Topaz Labs, Rytr and Pollo AI verified; Freepik renamed Magnific (publishes no rate); Adobe terms verified but Firefly eligibility unconfirmed; Canva closed (Canvassador-only); Pika and OpenRouter have no official program; Whop re-verified.
disclosure: Some links on this page are affiliate links. If you buy through them, I may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. I only recommend tools I actually use or have tested.
